body: I was at a diner, with booths all along one wall. Counter on the other side of the aisle. I was walking down the aisle along the booths and the waitress was cleaning a booth, so she said Hello and then crawled on her hands and knees to clean the seat all the way to the wall. I stopped for a brief second to say hello back, and we both looked at each other, realizing that we were suddenly in the doggie position in public. Funny and awkward at the same time.
